description: This file defines the RxServiceBind class, which provides reactive wrappers around Android service binding mechanisms using RxJava. It includes methods to bind to a service and manages the connection lifecycle with an internal Connection class implementing ServiceConnection and ObservableOnSubscribe.

classes.name: RxServiceBind
classes.description: Provides static methods to bind to Android services using RxJava Observables.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Internal class implementing ServiceConnection and ObservableOnSubscribe to manage service connection lifecycle and emit IBinder instances as Observables.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Creates an Observable that binds to a service with default flags.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Creates an Observable that binds to a service with specified flags.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Sets the ObservableEmitter to emit IBinder instances when the service is connected.
